topic: Host OS metrics missing with OpenTelemetry Collector
environment: OTel contrib collector DaemonSet exporting to Datadog
symptom_pattern: Pod and node metrics from kubeletstats arrive but system.cpu / system.mem metrics are missing for hosts sending through an OpenTelemetry collector.
root_cause: Host OS metrics need the hostmetrics receiver in the DaemonSet pipeline; it was deployed separately (or not wired into the metrics pipeline), so no system metrics were produced.
resolution_path: Review the collector config receivers and pipelines
Add hostmetrics to the DaemonSet's metrics pipeline (single collector per node)

qa_pairs.tse_question: Can you share the receivers and service.pipelines sections of the collector config?
qa_pairs.customer_answer: receivers: kubeletstats only; there's a separate hostmetrics collector a colleague set up.

qa_pairs.tse_question: Is the hostmetrics collector deployed as a DaemonSet?
qa_pairs.customer_answer: I think it's a Deployment with one replica.

customer_style.tone: knowledgeable about OTel, skeptical of vendor agents
